# Speech-MCP

> FastMCP 3.4 multi-provider speech gateway: **FunASR local STT (multilingual, EN/JA/DE)**,
> **sherpa-onnx streaming STT + barge-in (ja/en/de)**, Gemini Live/TTS, Hume, ElevenLabs,
> wake word, RAG, fleet voice command bus.

## STT

- **FunASR** (batch): MCP `transcribe_audio_file`, `transcribe_stream_chunk`; REST `POST /api/v1/transcribe?provider=funasr`. Enable `FUNASR_ENABLED=true` + `uv sync --extra funasr`, or sidecar `FUNASR_OPENAI_URL` on 10914.
- **sherpa-onnx** (streaming, ja/en/de): MCP `streaming_stt`, `barge_in_feed`. Enable `SHERPA_ASR_ENABLED=true` + `SHERPA_BARGE_IN=true` + `uv sync --extra sherpa`.

## Features

- Local STT: FunASR (VAD + ASR + punctuation + diarization) + streaming sherpa-onnx with barge-in
- Cloud TTS/live: Gemini, Hume, ElevenLabs; Windows SAPI5 fallback; Gemma local
- Wake word (openWakeWord); fleet voice delegate to fleet-agent
- RAG: LanceDB + `search_docs` / `ask_docs`
- Prefab UI cards (real provider status); dialogic returns; sampling via `ctx.sample()`
